versions.text:
Removable

ballast may be used to enable airplanes to comply with the flight requirements in accordance with the following provisions: (a) The place or places for carrying ballast shall be properly designed, installed, and plainly marked as specified in § 3.766. (b) The Airplane Flight Manual shall include instructions regarding the proper disposition of the removable ballast under all loading conditions for which such baHast is necessary, as specified in 8§ 3.766 and 3.777.
